gloss: to recommend, to advise, to encourage

definitions.explanation: To suggest something as good or suitable.
To persuade someone to do something.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}を{勧|すす}める。
{医者|いしゃ}に{運動|うんどう}を{勧|すす}められた。
examples.english: The doctor recommended exercise to me.

notes:
{勧|すす}める means to recommend.

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {勧|すす}める: to recommend
- {進|すす}める: to advance, to promote
- {薦|すす}める: to recommend (formal)

PATTERN:
- 〜を{勧|すす}める: to recommend ~
- 〜に〜を{勧|すす}める: to recommend ~ to someone
